entries.build_command: sh real-rxe/build_one.sh before && sh real-rxe/build_one.sh after
entries.run_command: sh real-rxe/run_one.sh before && sh real-rxe/run_one.sh after
entries.reachability_signal: QEMU serial marker PCAT_P099_REAL_RXE_DONE plus kernel gcov for umem.gcda; mock fallback marker PCAT_P099_MOCK_SUITE_PASS
entries.expected_signal: before RO->RW succeeds; after fails with nonzero ibv_rereg_mr return and errno=EACCES; control inputs preserve their acceptance class
entries.input_strategy: RXE/uverbs cases for RO->LOCAL_WRITE, legal REMOTE_WRITE/ATOMIC combinations, readonly, originally writable, PD-only, PD+ACCESS, ACCESS+TRANS, zero and invalid flags; identical mock matrix when QEMU cannot complete
entries.limitations: Host RXE is unavailable. QEMU is the only real uverbs path. If guest RXE/provider setup fails, mock validates helper and driver contracts but is not end-to-end coverage.

entries.reachability_signal: gcov count on copied helper return -EACCES and PCAT_P099_MOCK_DONE failures=0
entries.expected_signal: after access-only non-writable RO->RW returns -EACCES; CONFIG_USER_MEM=n returns -EOPNOTSUPP; invalid flag stays -EOPNOTSUPP
entries.input_strategy: Compare exact negative return/errno for helper, uverbs validation model and mlx4's retained ACCESS|TRANS -EPERM path
entries.limitations: Mock proves kernel helper/driver error contracts; only successful QEMU RXE results can prove libibverbs errno mapping.

entries.reachability_signal: per-driver JSONL effect sequence and gcov call counts for hns/irdma/mlx4/mlx5/rxe wrappers
entries.expected_signal: after helper=-EACCES each wrapper returns before mailbox/hardware/PD/MR side effects; mlx4 ACCESS|TRANS retains mpt_get then -EPERM
entries.input_strategy: Record ordered controlled-mock calls for rejected access-only and valid/control flag combinations across all five drivers
entries.limitations: Hardware APIs are deterministic mocks. Real hns/irdma/mlx4/mlx5 firmware, mailbox and device state are not exercised.
